title: Stable Candidate Adjacency Graph

house_boundary_bindings.basis: no proven exterior door; placeholder boundary node only

critical_findings: The candidate graph can now represent room-to-room adjacency without treating adjacency as a validated travel route.
Exterior is explicit as a node rather than being silently represented by an empty room side.
House 1 and House 2 have exterior-door candidates; House 3 has no proven exterior door in the current census.
No physical edge is bound to a logical application door contract yet.
No route is validated, no runtime navigation is changed, and no camera is finalized.
The graph contains disconnected/ambiguous physical regions; those are evidence, not defects to be repaired by invented edges.
next_gate: Compare only required logical transitions against graph reachability and identify exact missing physical bindings.
